# svp { #wass2s.svp }

```python
svp(T)
```

Calculate saturated vapor pressure (es) using FAO-56 Equation 3.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                              | Description                         | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------|-------------------------------------|------------|
| T      | xarray.DataArray or numpy.ndarray | Air temperature in degrees Celsius. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                              | Description                                                |
|--------|-----------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.DataArray or numpy.ndarray | Saturated vapor pressure in kPa, with same shape as input. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- Based on the Tetens equation as presented in FAO-56.
- Assumes input temperature is in Celsius.

## References {.doc-section .doc-section-references}

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop
evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements.
FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56.
